---
title: Workflow Hello World
format: html
---

The official [Hello World tutorial](https://inference.roboflow.com/guides/hello-world/) is a fast way to validate your setup.

In about five minutes, you:

1. build and run a simple **Workflow**
2. send data through a computer vision model
3. inspect the output in the UI debugger

::: {.callout-note}
Note: Select **Detatched** to run the Workflow Builder UI locally without a Roboflow account or API key.
:::
